mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS clazzName, COUNT(s.id) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(s.gender = 1), 0) AS maleCount, COALESCE(SUM(s.gender = 2), 0) AS femaleCount FROM clazz c LEFT JOIN student s ON s.clazz_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id
SELECT degree, COUNT(*) AS count FROM student GROUP BY degree ORDER BY degree
SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM student GROUP BY gender ORDER BY gender

SELECT co.name AS courseName, COUNT(ss.id) AS examCount, ROUND(AVG(ss.score), 2) AS avgScore, MAX(ss.score) AS maxScore, MIN(ss.score) AS minScore, ROUND(SUM(ss.score >= 60) * 100.0 / COUNT(ss.id), 1) AS passRate FROM course co LEFT JOIN student_score ss ON ss.course_id = co.id GROUP BY co.id ORDER BY co.id

SELECT CASE WHEN score >= 90 THEN '90-100' WHEN score >= 80 THEN '80-89' WHEN score >= 70 THEN '70-79' WHEN score >= 60 THEN '60-69' ELSE '0-59' END AS `range`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM student_score GROUP BY `range`

SELECT c.name AS clazzName, COUNT(v.id) AS violationCount, COALESCE(SUM(v.point), 0) AS totalPoints FROM clazz c LEFT JOIN student s ON s.clazz_id = c.id LEFT JOIN student_violation v ON v.student_id = s.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id

SELECT s.name AS studentName, c.name AS clazzName, s.violation_count AS violationCount, s.violation_score AS violationScore FROM student s LEFT JOIN clazz c ON s.clazz_id = c.id WHERE s.violation_count > 0 ORDER BY s.violation_score DESC, s.violation_count DESC, s.id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT d.name AS deptName, COUNT(e.id) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(e.status = 1), 0) AS activeCount, COALESCE(SUM(e.status = 2), 0) AS inactiveCount FROM dept d LEFT JOIN emp e ON e.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY d.id
